events.title: Elandrake Demo Release!
events.summary: Good afternoon, I'm excited to announce that the first public demo of Elandrake is now available for "An Event About Incrementals". The demo will feature around 30 minutes of gameplay focusing on the protogen's abilities, and players can progress the Entity to level 30! The main game will feature more of the Entity's abilities, such as root attacks on ships and objects entering via eccentric orbits! If you find any issues or need any help, please let me know!
